about_the_game:
Play the hit epic combat strategy game adventure where you face new challenges, fight stronger opponents, lead turn-based battles, protect your president status. Invade and conquer countries, grow a bustling economy, compete for 1st places in economy, culture and military power

Modern Age 2 - President Simulator is the best way to become a real president, lead real politics, manage your civilization. Plan your tactics, discover new technologies in the beset single player game for managing population, diplomacy, finances

CONTROL POPULATION

Monitor the president's rating to avoid riots, protests and revolutions. Build factories, mines, farms, bakeries, gardens, power plants, oil derricks, greenhouses, power plants, green energy. Fund the Ministry of Culture; hold concerts, film festivals, carnivals, the Davis Cup, FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games

MANAGE MINISTRIES

Fund and develop the Ministry of Health, Education, Infrastructure, Culture, Sports, Justice, police, ministry of defense, security service, national guard and others that help improve lives of citizens. Develop the Ministry of Tourism to turn your country into a world tourism hub, attracting millions of tourists. Build build wonders of the world: Eiffel Tower, Colosseum, Big Ben, Statue of Liberty

CONTROL FINANCES

Manage taxes, lend with interest, trade goods and resources, ask for help, take loans, research new economic technologies.

WARFARE

Build army and navy, train soldiers, gain experience in battles, send saboteurs and spies, research new war technologies. Build barracks, arsenals, airfields, hangars, shipyards, and warehouses. Study and build nuclear weapons, launch a nuclear strike on the enemy!

INTERNATIONAL POLITICS

Find friends among other countries, join international organizations, sign non-aggression pacts, defense alliances, trade and research agreements, open embassies. Vote in the UN and the UN Security Council, impose sanctions, and propose resolutions for voting

FACE CHALLENGES

Defend against pirate and terrorist attacks, fight disasters, epidemics, pandemics, protests, demonstrations, and economic downturns. A true president and leader is always ready to help their citizens in difficult times

Enjoy government management and realistic strategy game, Modern Age 2 - President Simulator is exactly what you've been looking for! Make strategic decisions and change course of history!

Turn your state into the most famous and powerful in the world, become the Best President!

*The game is designed for entertainment purposes only. Any similarities to the real world, real people and geopolitical situations are coincidental*

The game is also available on iOS, iPhone, iPad, Android.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Dual Core processor, 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core processor, 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
